# updater.ini fixtures for locale_branding_check.py

de, fr, ja, zh-CN, en-GB, and ar are unmodified copies of
`https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mozilla-l10n/firefox-l10n/main/<locale>/browser/updater/updater.ini`
fetched 2026-11-10, America/Chicago (UTC-6). Licensed under MPL 2.0, same as the
upstream files. They are test inputs only; they are not shipped in the product.

xx-TEST.ini and xx-MISSING.ini are synthetic cases (a leftover "Mozilla Firefox"
line, and a file with no MozillaMaintenanceDescription key).
